verdict.rationale: Fathom has a conversational meeting assistant, so a buyer could fairly ask whether external MCP servers can be plugged into it. The axis therefore applies. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Fathom as an MCP server that other AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT connect to. That is the opposite role and does not show Fathom consuming other MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
